name: Fill PDF Form
tagline: Type into the form's boxes and save a finished copy.
seoTitle: Fill in PDF forms online without uploading
description: Fill in PDF form fields for free in your browser: text, checkboxes, dropdowns and choices. Lock the answers if you like. Nothing is uploaded.

specs.Fields: Text, checkboxes, dropdowns, radio buttons and lists
specs.Not yet: Signatures, and forms that are just printed lines without real fields
specs.Works offline: Yes, once the page has loaded

faq.a: No. Forms often hold personal details, so it's filled inside this tab, and the page's security policy blocks it from sending data anywhere.

faq.q: It says my PDF has no fields. Why?
faq.a: Some forms are only printed lines, with no real fields inside the file. Those need a tool that places text anywhere on the page, which is planned.

faq.q: What does locking the answers do?
faq.a: It flattens the form: your answers become part of the page and can no longer be changed in a PDF reader.
